classification: analysis-only AGX shared command/result buffer completion probe

parent.supersedingReason: The same analyzer was extended after this preregistration to report post-completion shared-buffer pairs and to inventory the copied source inputs. The underlying first capture and its allocation verdict did not change.
parent.established: Of 27 ordinary CPU-mapped allocations, only the exact fragment result mapping changed after completion.

analysis.primaryQuestion: Which shared command/result-buffer words change on completion, and do any changed words identify TVB allocation, tile-list, or result/statistics addresses?
analysis.method: Pair buffers by identifier and length, enumerate changed byte and aligned-word spans, then join pointer-shaped words only against independently captured GPU allocation ranges and decoded command structures.

failClosed: Reject anything other than one completed command buffer and one hook call.
Reject a missing, duplicate, or size-mismatched shared-buffer pair.
Do not label a changed word as a pointer without an allocation or decoded-structure join.
Do not infer TVB contents merely from completion counters or statistics.
